title: Thai Cheese Quesadilla
description: A fusion of Thai and Mexican flavors, this cheesy quesadilla is a unique twist on traditional cuisine.
instructions: Heat a large skillet or griddle over medium heat.
Place a quesadilla in the skillet and sprinkle with Thai red curry paste.
Top with a slice of Portuguese cheese and a sprinkle of quick melted cheese.
Fold the quesadilla in half and cook for 2-3 minutes or until the cheese is melted and the tortilla is crispy.
Flip the quesadilla and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes or until the other side is also crispy and the cheese is melted.
Cut the quesadillas into wedges and serve hot.
Garnish with fresh basil and sliced chilies.
